notes_summary: Existing Redwood customer (embeddings + hosted API) expanding to contact center: goal is agent assist + ticket summarization across EU and APAC CCs. Wants predictable latency during spikes; evaluating Dedicated + Private for residency and compliance.
notes:
Background: NorthStar has used Redwood embeddings for knowledge search in support portal since 2024. They run a central support org (NA) and are now spinning up regional contact centers in EU (Dublin) and APAC (Sydney).

Conversation highlights: 
- 2026-02-11 demo: showed agent-assist flow + tool-calls (CRM writeback prototype). Elena: "Big value if answers are surfaced and actions can be executed without switching context."
- Security call 2026-03-02: submitted security questionnaire; flagged EU data residency + KMS/HSM as must-haves. Legal will not accept cross-border storage for EU tickets.
- POC: running voice->text pipeline + Redwood hosted for NLU; observed jitter at 800 concurrent calls during simulated sale week (latency spikes to 1.2s/turn). Want SLO <500ms for text-only agent assist and <800ms for voice-derived transcripts.
- Cost sensitivity: heavy burst behavior during product launches (2-4x baseline for 2-6 hours). Finance requested predictable commit for those windows vs pay-as-you-go volatility.

Stated requirements / asks: 
- Dedicated pools in EU + APAC with failover to NA (cold) but no cross-border data at rest.
- Model routing by intent: lightweight local model for simple routing + fallback to larger LLM for action generation.
- Tool-calling with safe controls + audit trail (must show who executed CRM writebacks).
- Retention controls: must support 30/90/365 day retention policies per region.

Sales notes / shorthand: 
- Upsell path = Dedicated capacity + Private control plane for EU region; Optimize product to tune batching/kv/cache for cost during spikes.
- Legal blocker: EU residency clause + SLA for peak availability. 
- Tech blocker: HSM integration timeline; security wants HSM for keys used in tool-calls.

Quoted lines from stakeholders: 
- Elena: "If you can guarantee no EU data at rest and predictable latency during our promos, we'll consolidate agents onto Redwood."
- Head of Infra: "Need clear rollback plan if latency spikes under promotions — can we have automatic fallback to smaller model?"
